sections.title: Our Approach
sections.subtitle: Attention to detail, precision in outcomes

sections.heading: Experience directed by iteration
sections.description: Linkfields follows a systematic, step-by-step approach which is often derived through blueprints and strategy based on real insights. Our experienced professionals are agile in their work, but also very thorough. Through the best combination of objectivity and subjectivity, we deliver results.

sections.heading: From AI strategy to *measurable business value*

items.title: Strategise & govern
items.description: Prioritise use cases, ROI and controls before build starts, so investment follows value and governance is designed in.

items.title: Accelerate & deliver
items.description: Faster go-live and less development effort, using our own software, reusable accelerators and Cyber-Safe Delivery.

items.title: Measure & optimise
items.description: Validate impact, adoption and savings, then optimise continuously against the outcomes we agreed together.

sections.description: Strategy, delivery and measurement are one connected cycle, from enterprise AI strategy and responsible governance to intelligent execution.

cards.description: We explore the scope of challenges that are being faced by employees or customers. We also determine which assets, platforms or services will accelerate outcomes and establish the most commercially viable solution

After discussion and deliberation, we agree on the hypothesis and determine what we need to prove first. Through our partners, we explore ways to maximise impact and boost change, finally drafting an initial project roadmap

Evolution helps us determine if any additional proof points are generating expected returns and make adjustments if necessary. We also determine if any additional proof points are required and decide which services are needed to support scale.
We explore ways to scale and drive a sustainable cultural change and identify what the delivery model requirements are. This helps us understand how to accelerate additional values.

sections.heading: We lead with *outcomes*, not offerings
sections.description: Every play starts from a customer problem. Our five portfolios and Linkfields software sit behind each one.

plays.title: AI Code Assurance
plays.trigger: AI-generated code increases delivery speed and assurance risk.
plays.outcome: Quality and security gates across CI/CD for AI-written change.

plays.title: Modernisation & Programme Assurance
plays.trigger: Complex migration and customisation create regression and integration risk.
plays.outcome: Migration readiness, automated regression, integration rebuild and security validation.
plays.ip: Linkworks, Modernisation & Integration Toolkit, testoriumz, Release Assurance Packs

plays.title: Regulated Cyber Readiness
plays.trigger: Regulated industries need continuous evidence, not point-in-time reports.
plays.outcome: Continuous exposure validation, control mapping and remediation evidence.

plays.title: Intelligent Operations
plays.trigger: Cost-to-serve pressure creates demand for process intelligence and automation.
plays.outcome: Discover, redesign and automate work across process and customer channels.
plays.ip: Linkworks, Intelligent Workflow Automation Framework, testoriumz, Cyber-Safe Delivery

plays.title: Capability Centres with Embedded IP
plays.trigger: Organisations need scalable delivery capacity with stronger governance and automation.
plays.outcome: Build-operate-transfer GCCs with quality, security and engineering IP embedded.
plays.ip: Linkworks, Delivery Governance, Quality Engineering IP, Cyber-Safe Delivery

sections.heading: Flexible *commercial models*

items.title: Fixed Price
items.description: Defined scope and outcome delivered against agreed milestones and acceptance criteria.

items.title: Time & Materials
items.description: Flexible delivery where scope evolves, with transparent rates and governance.

items.title: Managed Service
items.description: Ongoing service with SLAs, governance and continuous improvement built in.
items.footText: Application management, managed quality, managed security.

items.title: Dedicated Team
items.description: Persistent squads or specialist teams aligned to your priorities and ways of working.
items.footText: Product engineering, sustained capacity, capability centres (GCC).

items.title: Outcome-Based
items.description: Commercials linked to measurable business or operational outcomes, where these can be agreed and evidenced.

sections.description: One capability architecture, flexible commercial models. Buy a project, a managed outcome, a dedicated team, or our software on its own.
sections.note: Linkworks, testoriumz, VajraX and our AI SaaS solutions are available by licence, subscription or SaaS, with or without a Linkfields services engagement.
